dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The upper-right dorsal region contains four prominent closed or semi-closed ring structures. These exhibit sharp gradient transitions from dark charcoal exterior pixels to light grey interior bands. The perimeter geometry is irregular and non-uniform in thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density. Small clusters of 5-12 solid high-intensity pixels are visible on the far left flank and near the posterior taper, lacking internal gradients or ring-like structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct macro-annuli in the upper-right quadrant form an obtuse scalene triangle. The longest axis of this geometric relationship is oriented roughly parallel to the upper dorsal curvature.
